anchors.quote: page one you know You can have a section where you list your technologies because you know you want to be able to show whoever's reading your CV that you'got the required skill set

anchors.quote: is your location and right to work position obvious

anchors.quote: LinkedIn and networking and referrals they can actually be a bit more important than the CV because they help you escape the application queue

anchors.quote: a referral transfers some of the trust as well um it doesn't guarantee an interview or a job obviously but a hiring manager or somebody can look at your profile a bit more carefully

claim_en: A referral transfers some trust: it guarantees nothing, but a hiring manager can look at the profile a bit more carefully.

anchors.quote: a lot of the placements that that I would make in my early career all came from referrals i would say probably as much as like 70%

claim_en: Rather than a cover letter, put three or four strong sentences at the top of the CV, tailored per application: who you are, what you specialize in and why you fit the opportunity.

anchors.quote: if you're changing careers if you're relocating or you need to explain something unusual a short tailored note can really help you don't need a whole page cover letter

anchors.quote: it could be right to work could be sponsorship could be salary requirements could be relocation time scale could be family circumstances could be language time zone payroll background checks

anchors.quote: things come out in conversation where you know both parties can make it work whereas if you put it on your CV um it gives people a reason to to click past

claim_en: Bullet points are for achievements, not for repeating the skills list; a three-line bullet tells the hiring manager there is nothing in it.
quote_en: You make it three lines, and I understand there is nothing in it at all; you could not manage to write it concisely. / In the bullet points we should talk about our achievements; do not repeat your skills.

anchors.quote: ببین مطمئنم این کار بزرگی بوده
مسئله اینه که این آدم نتونسته خودشو درست حساب اینجا پرزنت کنه
این سه تا از این چار تا بلد پوینت فقط یه دونهشو اینجا گفته ۴ میلیون ریکوستو مانیتور کردم هیچ کدوم دیگه‌ای هیچ متریکی نداره

claim_en: For the senior backend CV (CV#06), the hiring manager is sure the work was big but the candidate could not present it: only one of four bullet points has a metric.
quote_en: Look, I am sure this was big work. / The problem is that this person could not present themselves properly here. / Of these four bullet points only one says 4 million requests monitored; none of the others has any metric.

anchors.quote: پروژه‌های تو رو نمی‌خوام بدونم
ببین د تا چیز داریم دیگه میگیم دستاورد یا صرفاً خروج خروجی این بود که کد کد زدم یه سرویس آوردم بالا این میشه خروجی
وقتی میگیم دستاور میا میگی که این مثلاً اومد رو انقدر یوزر تأثیر گذاشت این اومد انقدر درآمد واسه شرکت آورد

claim_en: Bullet points should state achievements, not output: "wrote code, brought up a service" is output; an achievement says how many users it affected or how much revenue it brought.
quote_en: I do not want to know your projects. / Look, we have two things: achievement, or just output; output is: I wrote code, brought up a service. / When we say achievement, you say this affected so many users, brought this much revenue to the company.

anchors.quote: واقعاً تو شرکت لارج اسکل تو هیچ نقشی نداری چون ایمپکتت هیچوقت نمی‌تونی تو بیای ادعا کنی آقا من فلان کارو کردم
یه تیم کوچیک توی توی هزار تا اینجینیر داری کار می‌کنی خب مثلاً نمی‌تونی بگی ادعا کنی من این کارو کردم
من که نمیتونم تنهایی بیام ادعا کنم من چند میلیون رونیو سیو کردم

claim_en: In a large company, where a small team works among a thousand engineers, a candidate cannot claim alone an impact that many others shared.
quote_en: Really, in a large-scale company you have no role [alone] because your impact; you can never come and claim, sir, I did such and such. / You work in a small team among a thousand engineers; you cannot claim I did this. / I cannot claim alone that I saved several million in revenue.

anchors.quote: تو این ۲ ساله عملاً هیچ چیزی نیست که تو سنجیده باشی
تو فقط بلدی کد بزنی و اصلاً رو خروجی کدا تمرکز نمی‌کنی
اینجور آدمو من کلاً شخصاً استخدام نمی‌کنم

claim_en: Two years at a company with nothing measured signals someone who only writes code and does not care about its outcome; the hiring manager personally rejects such a candidate.
quote_en: In these two years there is practically nothing you have measured. / You only know how to write code and do not focus on what the code produces at all. / I personally do not hire this kind of person at all.

anchors.quote: داره تو رو از اونور دنیا استخدام می‌کنه باید از لول اوریج تیم خودشون حداقل بهتر بود
پس داره یه سرمایه‌گذاری می‌کنه وقتی من می‌خوام همچین کاری رو انجام بدم من باید آدمی رو بیارم که حداقل تیم منو لول آپ کنه
حداقل اینه که از تیم من آدم بهتری باشه قوی‌تر از بچه‌های تیم من باشه

claim_en: Hiring someone from abroad is an investment of months, so the hiring manager must bring in someone better than the team's average who levels the team up.
quote_en: They are hiring you from the other side of the world; you must at least be better than their team's average level. / So they are making an investment; when I want to do this, I must bring someone who at least levels up my team. / At least they should be better than my team, stronger than the people on my team.

anchors.quote: اون نکته اولی که من باز می‌کنم تو فلش اول تو ۱۰ ثانیه ۳۰ ثانیه دارم نگاه می‌کنم تو این رزومه همینه

claim_en: The first look at a CV takes the hiring manager 10 to 30 seconds.
quote_en: The first thing I look for when I open it, in the first flash, in 10 seconds, 30 seconds of looking at this CV, is exactly this.

anchors.quote: من یه چیزی که همیشه واسه من ارزش بوده اونرشیپ بوده یعنی که طرفی که دارم می‌بینم تو رزومهش بباره که این آدم آدمیه که مسئولیت پذیر بوده
کسی بوده که فینیشه کسی بوده که تمام کننده کار بوده نه اینکه فقط تسک بگیره
برم میژر بسنجم کیپیآیمو بسنجم ببینم رسید اون برم ایت کنم هی برم بهترش کنم محصولمو مسئولیت پذیری واسه من یعنی اینه

claim_en: What the hiring manager always values on a CV is ownership: someone who takes responsibility, finishes the work rather than just taking tasks, and after release measures the KPIs and keeps improving the product.
quote_en: One thing that has always been valuable to me is ownership: that the CV I am looking at shows this person is responsible. / Someone who is a finisher, who completes the work, not someone who just takes tasks. / Go and measure, measure my KPI, see whether it got there, iterate, keep improving my product; that is what responsibility means to me.

anchors.quote: بعضی رزومه‌ها رو که می‌خونی سر پاش می‌باره که این آدم میاد صبح تا شب که فقط ساعتو بگذره

claim_en: Some CVs show the hiring manager a person who only passes the time doing a few tasks a day.
quote_en: Some CVs you read, it pours out of them that this person comes in from morning to night just to pass the time.

anchors.quote: لینک جایی رو می‌ذار دارید توی رزومه مطمئن شید که اون یه ارزش اضافه می‌کنه
استکور فلو کار اولاً که استکلو دیگه تو اسک د یک د سال اخیر کسی بازش نمی‌کنه دوم اینکه اونجام اکتیو نبودی

claim_en: Only link profiles that add value: nobody has opened Stack Overflow in the last year or two, and the senior backend candidate (CV#07) was not active there anyway.
quote_en: If you put a link somewhere in the CV, make sure it adds value. / Stack Overflow: first, in the last year or two nobody opens Stack Overflow; second, you were not active there either.

anchors.quote: ما الان تو شرکت خودم تو مصاحبهم من دسترسی سی به ایآی میدم الان من فردا یه مصاحبه دارم مثلاً دو طرف من دسترسی سی به ایآی فول میدم
چون کسی دیگه بدون ایآی کد نمی‌زنه

claim_en: In the hiring manager's own company, candidates get full AI access in interviews, because nobody writes code without AI any more.
quote_en: Now in my own company, in my interviews, I give candidates access to AI. / Because nobody writes code without AI any more.

anchors.quote: من جاوا اسکریپتو می‌بینم تایپ اسکریپت توش نیست جاوا اسکریپت بدون تایپ اسکریپت کی دیگه می‌زنه
بیشتر ۵ ساله هر کی جاوا اسکپت می‌زنه تایپ اسکریپتم باید بغلش باشه
بچه‌ها جاوا اسکریپت با تایپ اسکریپت جاوا اسکریپت خالی دیگه کسی استفاده نمی‌کنه سال‌هاست

claim_en: For the senior backend CV (CV#07), the hiring manager notes JavaScript without TypeScript as a gap: for more than five years, anyone writing JavaScript should have TypeScript beside it.
quote_en: I see JavaScript, but TypeScript is not in it; who writes JavaScript without TypeScript any more? / For more than five years, anyone who writes JavaScript must have TypeScript beside it.

anchors.quote: بیا اینجا رو نگاه کن شغل آخرش دوابپس بوده
دواپسی که ترافرم بلد نیست اصلاً خیلی سؤای زیادی تو رزومه پیش این رزومه ریجکته ریجکته

claim_en: The hiring manager rejects the senior backend CV (CV#07): its last role was DevOps, yet it shows no Terraform, and the CV raises too many questions.
quote_en: Come and look here: the last job was DevOps. / A DevOps engineer who does not know Terraform at all; too many questions come up in the CV; this CV is a reject, a reject.

anchors.quote: اوکیه که خب محدودیت بعضی موقع‌ها اجازه بهت نمیده دیگه

claim_en: Told that sanctions prevented a candidate from sharing numbers, the hiring manager accepts that restrictions sometimes do not allow it.
quote_en: It is OK; restrictions sometimes do not allow you [to give the numbers].

anchors.quote: این چرا اسم دانشگاه رو بولد کردی خیلی چیز مهمی بوده
اگه قراره بولد کنی بچه‌ها اگه قراره بلد کنی چیزی که چشم ببینه بگم ایول

claim_en: Do not bold routine items such as the university name; bold only something that makes the reader's eye say bravo.
quote_en: Why did you bold the university name, was it something very important? / If you are going to bold, friends, if you are going to bold, [bold] something the eye sees and says bravo.

anchors.quote: این چهجوری می‌تونسته یه جا فول تایم کار کنه کانترکتم کار کنه اصلاً بچه‌ها این خوب نیست این بده

claim_en: For the AI engineer CV (CV#08), the hiring manager reads a full-time job overlapping contract work as bad.
quote_en: How could this person work full-time in one place and also work a contract? Friends, this is not good at all; this is bad.

anchors.quote: من توصیه شدید می‌کنم که این کارو نکنید بچه‌ها اورلپ این دو تا اینا رو با هم نندازید مخصوصاً فول تایم
معمولاً شرکتا اجازه بهت نمیدن که اصلاً بری وقتی یه جای فول تایم یه جای دیگه کار کنی اصلاًم ارزش نیست

claim_en: Do not show a full-time job overlapping other work: companies usually do not allow it, and it is not worth showing.
quote_en: I strongly recommend you do not do this, friends: do not let these two overlap, especially full-time. / Companies usually do not allow you to work somewhere else while full-time; it is not worth it at all.

anchors.quote: مهم من کانتریبیوشنه اوکی ۸۵۰ تا داره بعدی خوبه
اپن سورس ۵صد و ۵۰۰ تا پلاس استار گرفته آره گیتابت خوب بود

claim_en: For the Android CV (CV#10), a GitHub with 850 contributions and an open-source project with over 500 stars counts as good with the hiring manager.
quote_en: What matters to me is the contributions; OK, there are 850; good. / Open source with 500-plus stars; yes, your GitHub was good.

anchors.quote: این دش دش ایآیه
آره آره دابل دشه فقط ایآی میذاره
همه می‌دونین ایآی نوشته

claim_en: For the Android CV (CV#10), the hiring manager reads a double dash (an em-dash) as something only AI puts in, a sign that AI wrote the text.
quote_en: This dash is an AI dash. / Yes, yes, it is a double dash; only AI puts it. / Everyone knows AI wrote it.

anchors.quote: اول از همه اینکه بچه‌ها اینا رو سعی کنید که اکشن وربا این جمله اول متفاوت باشه

claim_en: Start bullet points with action verbs, and vary the first word of each.
quote_en: First of all, friends, try to make these action verbs, the first word of each sentence, different.

anchors.quote: اگرم با ایندیپندنت آوردی بالا به نظرم نگو اینجا این مزیت نیست
من کسی می‌خوام که تو تیم بیاد کار کنه با خیلی مهمه یکی از مهم‌ترین فیچرا که ما می‌خوایم کسی رو استخدام می‌کنیم بتونه با تیم ما آداپت بشه

claim_en: In the hiring manager's view, do not present work as done alone: it is not an advantage, because the hiring manager wants someone who works in a team, and adapting to the team is one of the most important things looked for.
quote_en: Even if you brought it up independently, I think do not say so here; it is not an advantage. / I want someone who comes and works in the team; it is very important; one of the most important features when we hire someone is that they can adapt to our team.

anchors.quote: کسی که تنهایی کار کرده یا اون قبلیه بود یکی فریلنس کار کرده بود و اینا اینا مشکلاتی دارن که تجربه کار با تیم ندارن پس ممکنه باهاشون چالش داشته باشیم
اون یکی رو انتخاب می‌کنم که تجربه کار تیمی بهتر داشته باشه

claim_en: Candidates who worked alone or as freelancers may lack team experience and bring challenges; between two final candidates, the hiring manager chooses the one with better teamwork experience.
quote_en: Someone who has worked alone, or the previous one who worked freelance, has the problem of no experience working with a team, so we might have challenges with them. / I choose the one who has better teamwork experience.

anchors.quote: نه دعوتم می‌کنم باز دوباره ببینیم بچه‌ها همتون اینفرال جا انداختیدا
اینفرال لازمه این یه چیز خوب نیست باید داشته باشی

claim_en: For the four-year backend CV (CV#11), the hiring manager invites the candidate despite no infrastructure, while saying infrastructure is necessary.
quote_en: No, I will invite them anyway; again, friends, you have all left out infrastructure. / Infrastructure is necessary; this is not a good thing; you must have it.

anchors.quote: این چرا فارسیه اینجا ۱۰ پلسه اینو لطفا انگلیسیش کن
اینا رو حتماً انگلیسی کن

claim_en: For the senior PHP CV (CV#12), text left in Persian should be put into English.
quote_en: Why is this in Persian here? Ten plus; please put this in English. / Definitely put these in English.

anchors.quote: چند بار پی اچ پی رو تو رزومت گفتی چهار بار گفتی همش همون اول چهار بار گفتی رزومت انقدر تکرارش نکن دیگه یه جا نوشتی اوکیه

claim_en: Do not repeat the same technology many times: the senior PHP CV (CV#12) names PHP four times near the top, and once is enough.
quote_en: How many times did you say PHP in your CV? Four times, all at the start; do not repeat it so much; writing it in one place is OK.

anchors.quote: ریاکت ریاکت جی اس بیسیک چرا بیسیک ویو بیسیک
اون بیسیکه رو دوست نداشتم

claim_en: For the ten-year PHP CV (CV#12), the hiring manager did not like skills labelled basic, such as React basic and Vue basic.
quote_en: React, React.js basic; why basic? Vue basic. / I did not like that basic.

anchors.quote: تو بخش زبانش گفته انگلیش اینترمیت
ولی الان این به من میگه که این آدم نمی‌تونه اصلاً دیگه واسه من انگلیسی درستی صحبت کنه با تیم من اصلاً اگه همه چیشم اوکی بود اینجا رد میشد

claim_en: A language section saying English intermediate tells the hiring manager the candidate cannot speak proper English with the team: even with everything else OK, the CV is rejected on this.
quote_en: In the language section it says English intermediate. / But now this tells me this person cannot speak proper English with my team at all; even if everything else were OK, it would be rejected here.

anchors.quote: آره آره حتماً د تاشو با هم می‌نویسن

claim_en: Asked about JavaScript and TypeScript, the hiring manager says to write the two together.
quote_en: Yes, yes, definitely write the two together.

anchors.quote: من دعوتش می‌کنم برای مصاحبه پراجکت به خاطر اینکه دایورسی سیتیش تو اسکیلا و قسمتهای مختلف زیاد بود
تو ۳ سال نشون داد که آدمیه که علاقه‌منده رفته یاد گرفته فقط به اون د تا تکنولوژی که بلد بوده گیر نبوده رفته بیشتر یاد گرفته
به عنوان کسی که ۲ سال کار کرده رفته چیز مختلفی یاد گرفته علاقه‌بند به تکنولوژی و سافتور من این واسم مثبته

claim_en: The hiring manager invites the three-year frontend candidate (CV#13) because the CV shows a range of skills: in three years the candidate kept learning beyond the two core technologies, even backend.
quote_en: I invite them to an interview because of the high diversity in skills and different areas. / In 3 years they showed they are someone interested, who went and learned, was not stuck on the two technologies they knew, and learned more.

anchors.quote: ببین به هر حال می‌فهمه دیگه یعنی یا اونجا می‌فهمه یا دو روز بعدش بهت زنگ می‌زنه می‌فهمه
اولاً که اون کدا رو مگه مردم حفظن که ۹۸ مثلاً میشه ایران یا فلان بهمان کسی هم بیکار نیست بره سرچ کنه

claim_en: Asked whether an Iranian phone number is a reason to reject, the hiring manager says people do not know country dialling codes or take time to look them up; the location comes out anyway once the recruiter calls.
quote_en: Look, they will find out anyway: either there, or two days later they call you and find out. / First, do people memorize those codes, that 98 is Iran or whatever? Nobody has the time to go and search which country a code belongs to.

anchors.quote: ایآی اسستنت دولپمنت داره می‌بینید بولد کرد چشم گرفت اینو یعنی قشنگ همه رو اسکیپ کرد رسیدم اینجا اینو این اینو خوندم

claim_en: For the 13-year senior backend CV (CV#15), the bolded AI-assisted development caught the hiring manager's eye: everything else was skipped and that was read.
quote_en: It has AI-assisted development; you see, it is bold, it caught my eye; I nicely skipped everything, got here and read this.

anchors.quote: ما معمولا ماهها روم باید بزنیم بچه‌ها فقط سال نمی‌زنیم حتما رو می‌زنید اینجا از چه ماهی شروع کردید

claim_en: Give the months of each role's dates, not only the years, including the month the role started.
quote_en: We usually have to write the months too, friends; we do not write only the year; definitely write here from which month you started.

anchors.quote: اسم دانشگاه رو لطفاً بزنید دیگه نمیشه فقط یه بچلور داریم کامپیوتر سایت اسم دانشگاه بزن

claim_en: Give the university's name in the education section, not only the degree.
quote_en: Please write the university name; it will not do to have just a bachelor's in computer science; write the university name.

anchors.quote: بخش اسکیل کلاً نداره رضا همه رو همین تو اینجا نوشته
یه بخش اسکیلز بذار اونجا اسکیلاتو بنویس
بخش اسکیلو من میخوام دیگه ببینم الان چیا کار کردی

claim_en: Include a skills section: two CVs (CV#15 and CV#17) had none, and the hiring manager wants it to see what the candidate has worked with.
quote_en: There is no skills section at all; [the candidate] wrote everything here. / Put a skills section there and write your skills. / I want the skills section, to see what you have worked with.

anchors.quote: اسک سکشن کلا نداشت ولی دعوتش کردم مصاحبه یعنی حالا اونام نیست که صفر و یکی باشیم رو همه رزومه من کلیت رزومه رو نگاه می‌کنم

claim_en: The hiring manager invited the 13-year backend candidate (CV#15) despite no skills section: the decision is not all or nothing, it looks at the CV as a whole.
quote_en: It had no skills section at all, but I invited them to an interview; it is not that we are zero-or-one on every CV; I look at the CV as a whole.

anchors.quote: بهترین چیزی اینه که جابی که می‌خواید اپلای کنید بچه‌ها زیر اسمتون اون جابه رو بنویسید اگه فرانت اند انجینره اونجا می‌زنی فرانت اند انجینر

claim_en: Under the name, write the title of the job being applied for (frontend engineer for a frontend role).
quote_en: The best thing is, friends, to write under your name the job you want to apply for: if it is frontend engineer, you put frontend engineer there.

anchors.quote: با بیآی تیم کار کرده پس کراس تیم بلده کار کنه

claim_en: For the seven-year data analyst CV (CV#19), work with the BI team tells the hiring manager the candidate can work across teams.
quote_en: Has worked with the BI team, so knows how to work across teams.

anchors.quote: اسو نوشته اکسپرت ادونس اینترمیت نوید بعد این به نظر این نوشتن این مدل نه توصی نمی‌کنم اینجوریش کنی

claim_en: Do not label skills with proficiency levels such as expert, advanced, intermediate or novice.
quote_en: [The candidate] wrote expert, advanced, intermediate, novice; I do not recommend writing it this way.

anchors.quote: پاور بیآی ابزار اصلی توئه تو پاور بیآیت تو اینترمیتی به عنوان کسی که بیآی کار کرده ۷ سال الان خراب کردی که داشتم دعوتت می‌کردم

claim_en: For the seven-year data analyst CV (CV#19), rating the main tool (Power BI) as intermediate turned the hiring manager's invite into a borderline verdict.
quote_en: Power BI is your main tool and you are intermediate in Power BI, as someone who has done BI for 7 years; now you have ruined it; I was about to invite you.

anchors.quote: ایآی واسه من یه پارامتر خیلی مهمه قطعا توی بررسی

claim_en: AI on the CV is a very important parameter in the hiring manager's review.
quote_en: AI is a very important parameter for me in the review, definitely.

anchors.quote: سه خط تا چار خط ماکسیموم بیشتر از اون برای توی سامری نذارید

claim_en: The summary should be three to four lines at most.
quote_en: Three to four lines maximum; do not put more than that in the summary.

anchors.quote: ۲ سال اخیر ایآی خیلی چیزه خیلی خیلی تو شرکت‌ها مهم شده سعی کنید یه چیزی کار کردی اینجا بذارید
نه اینکه بگی با کلو کار کردم یا کرسر کار کردما یا چت چیپیتی کار کردم نه باهاش چیکار کردی خروجی باهاش
اگه کار نکردی تو کارتم حداقل یه جور دیگه‌ای تو پروژه آخر وقت آخر هفته چیزی کار کن تو سامیت یه جا بزن

claim_en: Show what the candidate built with AI, the output, not only the names of tools such as Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT; without AI work in the job, do a weekend project and mention it in the summary.
quote_en: In the last 2 years AI has become very, very important in companies; try to put here something you have worked on. / Not saying I worked with Claude or Cursor or ChatGPT, but what you did with it, the output. / Work on something in a weekend project and put it in your summary.

anchors.quote: به نظرم د تا رزومه کن یه دونه رو پی اچ پی کن یه دونه رو گو کن یه دونه هم میخوای اصلاً کلاً بکنش زبانشو در نظر نگیر

claim_en: For a candidate with two unrelated stacks (PHP and Go), the hiring manager suggests two CVs, one per stack, or none tied to a language.
quote_en: I think make two CVs: one for PHP, one for Go; or, if you want, one where you leave the language out entirely.

anchors.quote: من اینو نمی‌پسم یعنی به خودت ضرر زدی اینجا
تو اومدی خودتو کردی دو آدم گفتی من ۴ سال پی اچ پیام ۲ سال گوم
من این آدمو دعوت نمی‌کنم تو همین جای کار کفارت می‌کنه برای اینکه اینو دعوتش نکنم

claim_en: The hiring manager rejects the six-year PHP and Go CV (CV#22): presenting the candidate as four years of PHP plus two of Go, instead of as a software engineer, is enough on its own not to invite.
quote_en: I do not like this; you hurt yourself here. / You made yourself two people: four years of PHP, two years of Go. / I do not invite this person; this part alone is enough for me not to invite them.

anchors.quote: ببین من ۱۰ ثانیه وقت می‌ذارم رزومه رو بررسی می‌کنم ببینم توی اون چارچوب من هست یا نه؟
بعدش اگه رضایت‌بخش بود و تو چارچوب من بود میرم پایین بولت پوینت روم می‌خونم

claim_en: Asked whether tech breadth matters more than achievements, the hiring manager says the first 10 seconds only check whether the CV fits the job's frame; only then come the bullet points and the achievements.
quote_en: Look, I take 10 seconds to check the CV and see whether it is within my frame. / Then, if it was satisfactory and within my frame, I go down and read the bullet points too.

anchors.quote: حتی تو مصاحبه هم که میای من مثلاً دو سه تاشو پیک می‌کنم میگم تو این چیزی رو تو رزومت گفتی برام توضیح بده

claim_en: In the interview the hiring manager picks two or three bullet points from the CV and asks about them in depth.
quote_en: Even in the interview, I pick two or three of them and say: you said this in your CV, explain it to me.

anchors.quote: معمولیه زیر ۱۰۰۰ تا من میگم میگم معمولیه

claim_en: Under 1,000 GitHub contributions is ordinary to the hiring manager.
quote_en: It is ordinary; under 1,000, I say, I say it is ordinary.

anchors.quote: اجایل دیگه همه انجینرا اجیل کار کردن دیگه چیز خاصی اینجا واقعاً نیست

claim_en: Listing Agile adds nothing for the hiring manager: every engineer has worked Agile.
quote_en: Agile; all engineers have worked Agile; there is really nothing special here.

anchors.quote: چرا دانشگاه بالاه معمولاً وقتی این کارو می‌کنن که تازه فارغ تحصیل شده بشن و سقای کار نداشته باشن

claim_en: For the machine learning CV (CV#24), the recruiter asks why education is at the top: usually that is done by fresh graduates without work experience.
quote_en: Why is the university at the top? Usually people do this when they have just graduated and have no work experience.

anchors.quote: خب گروپ نکرده توصیه می‌کنم گروپ کنیم

claim_en: For the machine learning CV (CV#24), the recruiter recommends grouping the listed skills.
quote_en: Well, they have not grouped them; I recommend we group them.

anchors.quote: دقیقاً اگه ماشین لرنینگه من هیچ چیزی ندیدم حداقل انتصار داشتم بره یه چار تا پروژه زده باشی اونا بیا توضیح بده
هیچ چیزشون به اون به اون صورت واسه من جذاب نبود که بخوام دعوتش کنم دعوت نمیشه

claim_en: The hiring manager rejects the machine learning CV (CV#24), not inviting it: nothing on it shows machine learning, the hiring manager expected at least about four projects explained, and none of the jobs was attractive enough.
quote_en: Exactly, if it is machine learning, I saw nothing; at least I expected them to have done some four projects and explain them. / None of them was attractive enough for me to want to invite them; not invited.

anchors.quote: این آدم میره آدمای خوب و تاپو پیدا می‌کنه به عنوان یه لیست رزوماشونو می‌گیره
میرن با اون شرکت نگوشییت می‌کنن یا مذاکره می‌کنن میگن من یه آدم خوب دارم
میان به شما یه درصدی پول می‌گیرن بابت اون کار و میان معرفی می‌کنن رزومه شما رو

claim_en: Independent and freelance recruiters find strong candidates, keep their CVs on a list, and when a company opens a role they pitch a candidate to it and introduce the CV for a percentage fee.
quote_en: This person goes and finds the good, top people and takes their CVs as a list. / They go and negotiate with that company and say: I have a good person. / They take a percentage as payment for that work and introduce your CV.

anchors.quote: مصاحبه اولی که می‌گیری با این آدمه مصاحبه با خود شرکته نیست مصاحبه با اون ریکروتر است

claim_en: With an independent recruiter, the candidate's first interview is with that recruiter, not with the company.
quote_en: The first interview you get is with this person; the interview is not with the company itself, it is with that recruiter.

anchors.quote: اینا میرن برای تو کار پیدا می‌کنن
پس خیلی خوبه که این مدل ریکروترا رو باهاشون کانکشن بزنید
با اینجور آدما تو لینکدین کانکت بشید و به طور خاص ریکوتر ایجنسی هم هستند که مثل آژانسهای کاریابی
حتماً ظرفیت ریکروترها رو در نظر بگیرین باهاشونین کانکشین

claim_en: Connect on LinkedIn with independent and agency recruiters and use them as a channel, because they go and find jobs for the candidate.
quote_en: They go and find work for you. / So it is very good to connect with this kind of recruiter. / Connect with such people on LinkedIn. / Definitely consider what recruiters can do; connect with them.

anchors.quote: که ما با یه آژانس ریکروتری قرارداد داشتیم اینا قرار بود هفته‌ای مثلاً د تا سی وی برامون می‌فرستادن
با کوالیتی بالا که احتمال اینکه اینا برن جاب بگیرن خیلی بالا بود این باعث میشد چی باعث میشد که ما وقتمونو زیاد نذاریم واسه بررسی ده‌ها و صدها رزومه

claim_en: At a former employer of the recruiter, a contracted recruitment agency sent a few high-quality CVs a week, so the team did not spend time reviewing tens or hundreds of CVs.
quote_en: We had a contract with a recruitment agency; they were to send us, say, ten CVs a week. / With high quality, so the chance that they would get the job was very high; this meant we did not spend much time reviewing tens and hundreds of CVs.
notes: 'د تا' is likely 'ده تا' (ten); claim_en avoids the number.

anchors.quote: پس من به نظرم که حتماً بذارید توی رزومهتون
حتی اگه شرکت به طور خاص الان نخواد این یه پلاسه برای اینکه من می‌فهمم این طرف اگه من نیاز بشم

claim_en: Put technologies outside the target role on the CV: even if the company does not ask for them, they are a plus, because the hiring manager understands the candidate could help if needed.
quote_en: So in my view, definitely put it in your CV. / Even if the company does not specifically want it now, this is a plus, because I understand that this person, if needed...

anchors.quote: حجم ارتباطشم یهکم مهمه دیگه
یه چیزای خیلی خیلی بیرپت دیگه نباشه دیگه یعنی یه چیزا باشه بالاخره به اون شغله یه جورایی ارتباطی داشته باشه

claim_en: Technologies outside the target role should still relate to the job somehow; how related they are matters a little, and very unrelated ones should not be listed.
quote_en: How related it is matters a bit too. / There should not be things that are very, very unrelated; there should be things that relate to that job in some way.

anchors.quote: ما چند ده تا به راحتی چند صد تا وضع بعضیتشون بستگی به شغل
اگه فقط رو سایت بذاریم خب خیلی کمتر میاد به نسبت ولی وقتی میری ری لینکدین پست می‌کنی
وقتی میری تو سایتهای زیاد شیر می‌کنی یهو یه چیز تصاعدی یه عدد خیلی گنده‌ای میاد

claim_en: At the recruiter's company a role easily gets tens, for some roles hundreds, of CVs depending on the job; posted only on the company site it gets far fewer, while posting on LinkedIn and many job sites brings a very large number.
quote_en: We get several tens easily, several hundred for some, depending on the job. / If we only put it on the site, far fewer come in comparison, but when you post on LinkedIn... / When you share on many sites, suddenly an exponential, very big number comes in.

anchors.quote: این بررسی منج یه نفر دیگه بشینه رو این صندلی بشینه یه جور دیگه ممکنه جواب بده
شما اپلای می‌کنی ۱۰ تا شرکت د تاشون تو رو اکسپت می‌کنن ولی ۸ تا دیگه ریجکتش می‌کنن
چون آدمای مختلفی اون پشت نشستن

claim_en: The verdicts are one screener's review: someone else in the same chair might answer differently, which is why two of ten companies may accept a CV and eight reject it, because different people sit behind them.
quote_en: This review is mine; if someone else sat in this chair, they might answer differently. / You apply to 10 companies, two of them accept you but the other 8 reject it. / Because different people sit behind it.

anchors.quote: معمولاً وقتی که وقت داریم می‌ذاریم اپلای کن مثلاً یهو یه باکت خیلی زیادی مثلاً می‌بینیم توی اونجا هست
همین که اپلای می‌کنه شاید روزی دو بار مثلاً من برم چک کنم
نگاه می‌کنم این خوب بود همونجا دعوتش می‌کنم

claim_en: When there is time to fill a role, the recruiter lets applications build up and then reviews the batch quickly; for an urgent role they check new applications perhaps twice a day and invite or reject each candidate on the spot.
quote_en: Usually when we have time, we let people apply, and suddenly we see a very big bucket there. / As soon as someone applies, maybe twice a day I go and check. / I look; this one was good, I invite them right there.

anchors.quote: من تو رلای اخیری که داشتیم من هایرینگ منیجر بودم و نفر اول مصاحبه هم خودم
این باعث شد که حجم خیلی زیادی همونجا اولش من ریجکت می‌کنم
میان من سعی می‌کنم خیلی سختگیر باشم رو مرحله اولش چرا چون مرحله دوم سوم یعنی وقت بقیه بچه‌ها تیمم می‌خوان بگیرن

claim_en: In the recruiter's recent roles as hiring manager, they ran the first interview themselves instead of the recruiter, rejected a large share at that stage, and stayed strict there because later stages take the team's time.
quote_en: In the recent roles we had, I was the hiring manager and the first interviewer was me myself. / This meant that I reject a very large volume right there at the start. / Those who come, I try to be very strict in the first stage. Why? Because the second and third stages take the time of the rest of my team.

anchors.quote: اگه چند ماه بازه اینا استخدام بکن نیستن آره مسخره بازیه خیلی از شرکتا هستن که فقط الکی جاو
فقط می‌خوام بگم تو مارکت بگم ما مثلاً استخدام داریم
این کم نیستن شرکتهایی که این مدلین
اگه جدی باشه شرکت تو کمتر یک ماه باید ببنده جابشو اگه بیشتر نگه می‌داره واقعاً اونا استخدام بکن نیستن

claim_en: Many companies post job ads without intending to hire, to show the market they are hiring; a serious company closes a role in under a month, so one left open for several months is likely not a real opening.
quote_en: If it is open for several months, they are not hiring; it is a farce; many companies just post fake jobs. / I just want to tell the market that we are hiring. / Companies like this are not few. / If the company is serious, it should close the job in under a month; if it keeps it longer, they are really not hiring.

anchors.quote: یا فقط باز می‌کنن برای کسی که آردی خودشون میخوان استخدام کنن
معمولا م میگی رفر کن یعنی یه نفر داخلی رفر بود

claim_en: Some roles are opened only for someone the company already wants to hire, usually an internal referral.
quote_en: Or they only open it for someone they already want to hire. / Usually you say: refer; that is, someone internal was referred.

anchors.quote: وقتی صحبت از اسپانسرشیپ می‌کنیم یعنی یه پروسه اداری چند ماهه استارتآپ معمولاً خیلی کاراشون سریعه
کپریتها یه مقدار بیشتر وقت دارن کلاً حالا مثلاً ۶ ماه بشه مثلاً ۸ ماه بشه باز اوکیه

claim_en: Sponsorship means an administrative process of several months; startups usually move fast and want roles filled quickly, while corporates have more time, and six or eight months is still fine for them.
quote_en: When we talk about sponsorship, it means a multi-month administrative process; startups usually do things very fast. / Corporates have somewhat more time; say it takes 6 months or 8 months, it is still okay.

anchors.quote: پس توصیههم اینه که اولاً که واسه همشون بذارید فیلتر نکنن سمت خودت بذار اوناو فیلتر کنن نه شما

claim_en: Apply to both startups and corporates; let the companies filter, do not filter yourself.
quote_en: So my advice is, first, apply to all of them; do not filter on your side; let them filter, not you.

anchors.quote: ما می‌تونیم اسپانسرشیپ بشیم
ولی واسه رلای جدید نمی‌خوایم که اسپانسر بشیم دلیلش اینه که پروسه اداری وقت بیشتر می‌گیره
شرکت با شرکت متفاوته و و رول به رولم متفاوته

claim_en: The recruiter's company can sponsor visas but does not want to for new roles because the administrative process takes longer; whether a company sponsors differs by company and by role.
quote_en: We can sponsor. / But for new roles we do not want to sponsor; the reason is that the administrative process takes more time. / It differs from company to company and from role to role.

anchors.quote: رزومت بنداز اونجا جاب پستشم بنداز اونجا بگو آقا می‌خوام برم اینو اپلای کنم بهم بگو که مشکل چیه
دوباره بنویس سعی کن سعی کن یه چیزی در مورد فراتر از رزومه در مورد خودت بگی

claim_en: To match a job post, give an AI assistant the CV and the job post, ask what is wrong and which skills are missing, give it context about yourself beyond the CV, and have it rewrite the CV.
quote_en: Put your CV in there and put the job post in there too; say: I want to apply for this, tell me what the problem is. / Rewrite; try, try to say something about yourself beyond the CV.
notes: JA also contradicts STR-6 earlier in S001 (keep it general, apply widely); with this claim JA is on both sides.

anchors.quote: اگه استفاده می‌کنید حتماً تو رزومتون اشاره کنید بهش چرا چون تو یکی دو سال اخیر مخصوصاً یک سال اخیر فوق‌العاده شرکتا دارن کار می‌کنن

claim_en: Whatever the job, if you use AI, mention it on the CV, because in the last year or two companies have been working with AI extremely heavily.
quote_en: If you use it, definitely mention it in your CV. Why? Because in the last one or two years, especially the last year, companies are working with it enormously.

anchors.quote: اشکال نداره فیل شده باشه شما یه بازی کار کردی یه سال ۲ سال ۵ سال کار کردی یه جایی بالاخره اون رزومه رو می‌زنی
استارتآپ اتفاقاً فیل میشه درصد بالایی از استارتپا فیل میشن طبیعیه

claim_en: Experience at a startup that failed is not a problem on the CV: list it like any other job, since a high share of startups fail and that is natural.
quote_en: It is fine that it failed; you worked somewhere for a year, 2 years, 5 years; you put it on the CV after all. / Startups do fail; a high percentage of startups fail; it is natural.

anchors.quote: یه یه گپ خیلی گنده‌ای برای بچه‌ها حالا چه فرانتن چه بک اند چه دبابس داریم می‌بینیم اینه که تستینگشون واقعاً تجربه استفاده از ابزارهای تستینگ رو ندارن
مشکل گندهتر تستینگ هیچی دارم نمی‌بینم
این این طرف اصلاً تست نمی‌زنه ۶ سال تجربه داره یه بار نشد بره یاد بگیره تستینگ چیه

claim_en: A very big gap the hiring manager sees in frontend, backend and DevOps candidates is lack of experience with testing tools.
quote_en: A very big gap we see in the candidates, whether frontend, backend or DevOps, is that they really lack experience using testing tools. / The bigger problem: testing, I see nothing. / This person does not write tests at all; six years of experience and never once went to learn what testing is.
notes: Split from JA-30 by the S001 verification.
